_comment: Curated, hand-picked area definitions for scripts/extract_city_roads.py and extract_city_buildings.py --area <id>. Any id NOT listed here is instead resolved dynamically: as a raw 'south,west,north,east' bbox if it parses as four floats, or as a real place name geocoded via Nominatim otherwise (see scripts/city_area.py). This registry only needs entries for areas worth re-running/re-verifying by a short, memorable name.

klosterneuburg_center.name: Central Klosterneuburg, Austria
klosterneuburg_center.description: A few real city blocks around central Klosterneuburg, Austria

vienna_stephansplatz_karlsplatz.name: Vienna: Stephansplatz to Karlsplatz
vienna_stephansplatz_karlsplatz.description: Dense old town: U1/U2/U4 underground, trams, 1600+ buildings (real OpenStreetMap data, fetched on demand)

korneuburg_hauptplatz__austria.name: Korneuburg Hauptplatz, Austria
korneuburg_hauptplatz__austria.description: About 220 m around Korneuburg Hauptplatz, Austria
